selectionRules: This directory is the canonical golden PRD source for BIO.
Historical draft/source PRD packs were consolidated here and removed from the working tree.
Service repos receive copied subsets from this directory under their own ai/output/prds folders.
Use git history for old source-pack provenance; use this directory for implementation.
